MARTYR.ClassDescription: The Martyr understands that suffering is the ultimate path to self-realization. They obtain their powers through a profound connection to either the Sun or the Moon, aligning with paths of Mercy or Vengeance.

Paths.MoonDescription: Disciples of the Moon see death as the ultimate judgment and suffering as the inevitable journey towards it.
Paths.SunDescription: Disciples of the Sun believe that suffering can be transcended through compassion and healing.

BloodMagic.Name: Blood Magic
BloodMagic.Description: These spells consume Vengeance or Mercy points instead of spell slots.

Notifications.MercyGained: {actor} gained {points} Mercy points from witnessing suffering!
Notifications.ExcessPointsFade: Excess {resource} points fade after a long rest.
Notifications.MoonPathRequired: This spell requires the Path of the Moon!
Notifications.SunPathRequired: This spell requires the Path of the Sun!

Dialogs.GrantMercyContent: An ally has taken {damage} damage. Grant {points} Mercy points?
Dialogs.RetributionContent: Spend Vengeance/Mercy points to activate Retribution:
